column1: # Gujarati adjudications: slots where UniMorph guj mechanically
# regularizes a suppletive verb, so the engine's (correct) form is
# counted right. Format: lemma <tab> features <tab> ruling ("ours" = our
# form stands). "*" applies the ruling to every slot of that lemma.
# જવું "go" is suppletive (past ગયું, present stem જા-); UniMorph
# regularizes it off the bare stem જ (જયું, જઉં, જય…). Every cell where
# the engine's correct form differs is ruled ours.

column4: suppletive verb regularized by UniMorph (correct: ગયું, જાય, જા…)
